description: Calculate days late, penalty fees and total due on an overdue invoice from the due date and a monthly penalty rate.

faqs.a: Days late = as-of date − due date (0 if not yet due). Fee = invoice × monthly rate × days ÷ 30.
faqs.q: How is the late fee calculated?

faqs.a: Simple pro-rated monthly fee here. If your contract compounds monthly, compute month by month instead.
faqs.q: Is the fee simple or compounding?

faqs.a: Set the as-of date to the payment date to see exactly what was owed when the invoice was settled.
faqs.q: What date should I use as "as of"?

howto: Enter the invoice amount, due date and monthly penalty rate.
Set the as-of date (defaults to today).
Read days late, the fee and the total due.
title: Invoice Late Fee Calculator
